method: Independent city/state select over latest succeeded dataset ingest; no production parser used
sql:
WITH chosen AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT ON(sd.dataset_key) sd.dataset_key,sr.id,sr.release_key,sr.content_sha256,sr.source_modified_at,sr.retrieved_at,ir.id ingest_run_id
 FROM source_dataset sd JOIN source_release sr ON sr.source_dataset_id=sd.id JOIN ingest_run ir ON ir.source_release_id=sr.id AND ir.status='succeeded'
 WHERE sd.dataset_key IN ('nursing-home-provider-information','home-health-care-agencies','hospice-general-information')
 ORDER BY sd.dataset_key,sr.source_modified_at DESC NULLS LAST,ir.completed_at DESC
), requested(kind,city,state) AS (VALUES ('nursing_home','AUSTIN','TX'),('home_health','HOUSTON','TX'),('nursing_home','TAMPA','FL')),
cohorts AS (
 SELECT 'nursing_home' kind,f.city,f.state_code,pi.identifier_value ccn,f.provider_name,c.*,f.overall_rating::numeric rating
 FROM chosen c JOIN facility_snapshot f ON f.source_release_id=c.id AND f.ingest_run_id=c.ingest_run_id
 JOIN provider_identifier pi ON pi.provider_id=f.provider_id AND pi.issuer='CMS' AND pi.identifier_type='CCN' AND pi.valid_from IS NULL
 WHERE c.dataset_key='nursing-home-provider-information' AND ((upper(trim(f.city))='AUSTIN' AND f.state_code='TX') OR (upper(trim(f.city))='TAMPA' AND f.state_code='FL'))
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 'home_health',h.city,h.state_code,h.cms_ccn,h.provider_name,c.*,h.quality_of_patient_care_star::numeric
 FROM chosen c JOIN home_health_snapshot h ON h.source_release_id=c.id AND h.ingest_run_id=c.ingest_run_id
 WHERE c.dataset_key='home-health-care-agencies' AND upper(trim(h.city))='HOUSTON' AND h.state_code='TX'
)
SELECT kind,upper(trim(city)) city,state_code,release_key,content_sha256,source_modified_at,retrieved_at,count(DISTINCT ccn) count, (array_agg(ccn ORDER BY provider_name,ccn))[1:3] sample_ccns,(array_agg(provider_name ORDER BY provider_name,ccn))[1:3] sample_names
FROM cohorts GROUP BY kind,upper(trim(city)),state_code,release_key,content_sha256,source_modified_at,retrieved_at ORDER BY kind,city
